findings.issue: 'It is small: it fits within two weeks' is a sizing claim with no source shown; it conflicts with R-03756, which found no size.
Section 15 says empty, error and no-access are Not specified, but §5 defines them through X1, X3 and X6.
Section 15 has no Loading row, although the item lists the loading state.
X6 says no §7 criterion covers it, but the §16 mapping puts its test TC-E2-015-11-ITG under AC1.
§16 text calls Covers AC5 to AC10 legacy numbers, but new rows -12 to -14 use AC5 to AC7 of §7.
Disposition note says owned criteria are AC1 to AC5; the story now has AC1 to AC7.
